# Case 1: n = 0
{"n":0}
@ no elements → empty partition
{"partition":[]}

# Case 2: n = 1
{"n":1}
@ single element → [0]
{"partition":[0]}

# Case 3: n = 3
{"n":3}
@ each index in its own partition → [0,1,2]
{"partition":[0,1,2]}

# Case 4: n = 5
{"n":5}
@ each index in its own partition → [0,1,2,3,4]
{"partition":[0,1,2,3,4]}
